F1_cost_gap.verdict: COST-GAP FIRED (clause F1). The bound is 45.59 ms/tick on today's machine state -- 13.7x the budget. At the receipt's machine state (23.26 ms full loop) the same removals leave 22.40 ms/tick -- 6.7x the budget. THE VERDICT IS MACHINE-STATE-INDEPENDENT: no composition of byte-neutral removals reaches 300 Hz on this body.
F1_cost_gap.residual_named: THE INTEGRATION CORE ITSELF: 97.1% of the tick is step.integrate -- 87.9% of the tick is Model::evaluate() (the 18-coordinate FK: frames, mass matrix, bias, contact rows) executed ~287 times/tick by (a) the RK4 (4 rate() calls per free_step, 29.4 free_steps/tick incl. the 42-iteration event-bisection free_steps) and (b) the impact/event machinery. The cost is the EQUATION COUNT of the derived physics (f64 FK Jacobians at 4 RK4 substages x ~11 advance calls/tick), not harness, not serialization, not sync, not allocation.
